designer-initial.summary: Selected a closed small monitoring-start and impedance-acquisition coordinator with 5 semantic usages, 12 interactions, 12 ordered cases, 5 scenario families, and one principal state/decision owner.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset express the Monitoring Decision Owner's two local state variables, initialization, explicit pre-state references, twelve ordered effective guards, and same-evaluation next-state/command relation without duplicating the principal decision or leaving state unconstrained?

What one-root containment and delegation mapping preserves exactly 5 semantic usages, semantic depth 1..2, one weak semantic region, and all 12 end-to-end semantic interactions while reporting required support usages and raw connections separately as uncounted generated support?

Can the joint 24-value acquisition-evidence relation, producer-total delivery relation, and prioritized Doctor-status relation each be represented as owner-local nonidentity contracts without central recomputation that would invalidate semantic-usage credit?

Can a deterministic analyzer exhaust all 864 raw input/state snapshots, report the induced 120 qualified snapshots, witness all 12 effective cases and 5 scenario families, and check unreachable anomalous delivery pairings without becoming a second architectural decision owner?

model-review.summary: The selected 5/12/12/5 allocation is realizable unchanged and all five usages own nonidentity local behavior.

findings.evidence: Extensionally, PART-01 has result fibers 3/1/1/1 over six raw request samples, PART-02 has fibers 18/3/1/1/1 over twenty-four acquisition-evidence samples, PART-03 performs state-dependent twelve-case selection, PART-04 has fibers 7/1/1/1 over command x evidence, and PART-05 has prioritized fibers 10/10/12/19/19 over disposition x evidence x command. None is a copy, bundle, bijective code translation, rename, or reroute wrapper.

SysML-AADL library commit 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 and the trusted Isolette patterns support System-to-Process-to-Thread containment, structured Data attributes, directed typed ports, PortConnection, fan-out, Thread-local GUMBO state, initialize, compute_cases, and In(state). Sireum build 4.20260630.386eac9f accepted a retained source using these patterns with exit 0 and Well-formed! during this review.

One root System, one behavior-free uncredited support Process, five semantic Threads at depth 2, twelve raw boundary-delegation connections, and six direct inter-Thread connections realize exactly INT-01 through INT-12 in one weak semantic region. GUMBO compute cases are conjunctive, so the already-required PRIORITY-01 exclusions must be explicit rather than relying on first-match behavior.

Independent enumeration covers exactly 864 raw snapshots with CASE-01..12 counts 756/24/12/12/12/6/6/12/6/6/3/9 and exactly 120 qualified snapshots with counts 48/16/8/8/8/6/2/8/6/2/3/5. Every case has a reachable scenario form, so a dependency-free analyzer can check the local relations and five scenario families without becoming a second owner.

The System Abstract declares executable_profile false and preserves physical acquisition, timing, clinical, safety, proof, code-generation, execution, and production claims in DEFER-01. The logical mapping does not activate executable-agent obligations or expand that claim boundary.
